newsitem.title: USA: Boston Gas allowed additional revenues on appeal.
newsitem.headline: Boston Gas allowed additional revenues on appeal.

text.p: Eastern Enterprises said Monday regulatory reconsideration of its Boston Gas Co subsidiary's November 1996 rate increased annual revenues about $1.3 million over the five years of the plan.
Eastern said the increase, due to an adjustment in the utility's productivity factor, will be effective in November.
On June 1, spokeswoman Jane McCahon said Boston Gas will begin collecting a $1.9 million, one-time adjustment of the $6.3 million revenue increase granted last November.
Eastern described the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities' response to Boston Gas' request for reconsideration, clarification and recalculation of the November 1996 rate Order as positive.

It said the department reduced the productivity factor portion of the performance-based rate formula established in November 1996 by 50 basis points, to 1.50 percent from 2.00 percent. The department also made a number of requested changes to the components of the service quality index included within the performance-based rate plan against which Boston Gas' service quality will be measured.
"Although we are still reviewing the implications of
the final decision, we believe the Department has responded fairly to Boston Gas' request for reconsideration," Eastern chief executive J. Atwood Ives commented.

The adjustments "should allow Boston Gas to earn more competitive returns, commensurate with its ability to increase natural gas throughput on its distribution system, improve productivity and control costs."

Primary issues remaining to be addressed in future proceedings include unbundling residential customers, exiting the merchant function (the purchase and resale of natural gas) and resolving capacity release (already approved on an interim basis in the Department's November 1996 Order).
Boston Gas' proposal for unbundling commercial and industrial customers was approved by the Department in its November 1996 order, effective January 1, Eastern noted.
